verdict.rationale: Databricks documents Structured Streaming, which runs streaming computation the same way as batch, with Delta Lake tables as exactly-once streaming sources and sinks. It also documents Auto Loader for incrementally processing new files as they arrive, Lakeflow pipelines for ETL, a real-time mode with end-to-end latency as low as 5 ms, and streaming tables and materialized views as objects. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming and incremental pipelines in production, and detailed evidence of the declarative-pipeline semantics.
